feed.title: Greek News Aggregator — Daily Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories scraped from kathimerini.gr

entry.title: Το Πεντάγωνο εξετάζει απόσυρση έως και 40.000 Αμερικανών στρατιωτών από την Ευρώπη
entry.summary: The Pentagon is weighing a drastic cut to the US military presence in Europe that could reach as high as 40,000 troops — up to 50% of the current force. If carried out, it would be the biggest drawdown since the 1990s and the end of the Cold War.

entry.title: Τουρκία για Μητσοτάκη: Η επίσκεψη στο Καστελλόριζο «δεν συμβάλλει στην ειρήνη»
entry.summary: Ankara is doubling down on rhetoric about a 'threat' from the eastern Aegean islands and the Greece-Israel partnership, focusing on Mitsotakis's Kastellorizo visit, which it says 'does not serve peace.' Turkey's defense ministry confirmed commando movements to Söke, opposite Samos.

entry.title: Χαμηλότερο από το 2010 το εισόδημα των Ελλήνων το 2025
entry.summary: According to Eurostat, Greeks' median disposable income in 2025 was 22.3% lower than in 2010, while across the EU it was 25.4% higher. Greece and France are the only EU-27 states with income below 2010 levels, with Greece's third-lowest in purchasing-power terms.

entry.title: Κάθε χρόνο και χειρότερο το στεγαστικό πρόβλημα
entry.summary: Greece's housing squeeze is worsening: home ownership fell to 69.4% in 2025 from 75.1% in 2015, and one in four Greeks spends at least 40% of income on housing — the worst rate in Europe. Rents outpace meager income gains, with real wages stagnant in 2025.

entry.title: Αναζητούνται 2 εκατομμύρια εξαφανισμένοι ψηφοφόροι
entry.summary: Party machines are hunting for the more than two million voters who 'vanished' from the ballot box between 2004 and 2023, as turnout fell from 76% to a record low of 53%. Veteran pollsters say high abstention traditionally favors the leading party and will be a key factor in the spring elections.

entry.title: «Mόνη λύση η αυτοδυναμία»
entry.summary: In an ERT interview, Kyriakos Mitsotakis called a single-party majority a 'realistic proposal,' ruling out cooperation with Velopoulos or Latinopoulou while making a fresh overture to Karamanlis. He announced heating-oil relief kicking in below €1.75 and said the interconnector cable would be laid 'soon.'

entry.title: Ενεργειακό ράλι: Επιστρέφει στην Ε.Ε. η συζήτηση για φόρο στα υπερκέρδη
entry.summary: A sharp rise in oil and fuel prices is reviving the EU debate on a windfall-profits tax, with six countries (Germany, Spain, Italy, Poland, Portugal, Austria) asking the Commission to examine energy firms' profits. The issue tops the agenda of the informal ECOFIN in Dublin.

entry.title: ΠΑΣΟΚ για Πλεύρη: Γνώριζε τους γιατρούς του Μαζωνάκη από το 2012 – Ηταν μαζί στη διοίκηση σωματείου
entry.summary: PASOK is demanding explanations from Migration Minister Thanos Plevris, claiming he knew the two jailed doctors in the Mazonakis case since 2012, when they were co-founders of a professional association. It accuses him of lying about when the acquaintance began and asks whether he knew of the illegal medical practices.

entry.title: Μητσοτάκης σε Τασούλα: Δύσκολος χειμώνας σε περιβάλλον πρωτοφανών γεωπολιτικών αναταράξεων
entry.summary: PM Kyriakos Mitsotakis warned President Tasoulas of a 'difficult winter' amid unprecedented geopolitical turmoil, making heating oil a priority. The plan foresees a twin intervention — a subsidy plus a higher heating allowance — while the fuel excise tax will be raised at the European Council.

entry.title: Πέθανε η Μαργαρίτα Παπανδρέου
entry.summary: Margarita Chant-Papandreou, the US-born wife of Andreas Papandreou and mother of Giorgos Papandreou, has died at 103. She was central to laws that advanced Greek women's status, including abolishing the dowry, legalizing abortion and instituting civil marriage.

entry.title: Aρση της ασυλίας Αβραμόπουλου για το Qatargate
entry.summary: Parliament's plenary lifted the immunity of former EU Commissioner and ND MP Dimitris Avramopoulos over Qatargate, 264 in favor of 266 present. In a memo he says he took part in no illegal activity and will appear voluntarily before Belgian authorities; Zoi Konstantopoulou's immunity was also lifted.

entry.title: Δημοσκόπηση: Τι κυβέρνηση προτιμούν οι πολίτες
entry.summary: A new Marc poll for ANT1 shows a narrow edge for a single-party ND (27.8%) over an ELAS-PASOK-led left coalition (27.1%). Some 55% rate Mitsotakis's TIF announcements negatively, while 12.1% say they might vote for a possible Samaras party.

entry.title: Τέλος εποχής: Ο Γουόρεν Μπάφετ παραιτήθηκε από την προεδρία της Berkshire Hathaway
entry.summary: Warren Buffett, 96, resigned as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway, taking the role of chairman emeritus, with his son Howard becoming chairman. 'Time always wins,' he wrote to shareholders, completing a broad transition at the company's top.

entry.title: Θεωρείο: Παρτίδα πόκερ
entry.summary: The Theoreio column reads the 'high-stakes poker' between Mitsotakis and Karamanlis, with the PM trying to pull his predecessor away from Samaras by calling him 'identified with New Democracy.' It also notes MEP Afroditi Latinopoulou's viral broadside against von der Leyen.

entry.title: Εντός και Εκτός: H περιστρεφόμενη πόρτα μεταξύ ΠΑΣΟΚ – ΕΛΑΣ – ΣΥΡΙΖΑ
entry.summary: A revolving door of officials is spinning on the center-left, with Olga Gerovasili's statement read as a prelude to joining Tsipras's ELAS and Roza Vrettou quitting PASOK. The moves sharpen the derby for second place between PASOK and ELAS.

entry.title: ΔΥΠΑ: Συνολικά 717.926 εγγεγραμμένοι άνεργοι τον περασμένο Αύγουστο
entry.summary: Registered jobless at labor agency DYPA reached 717,926 in August 2026, down 9.2% year on year but up a marginal 0.4% from July. Women make up 69.4% of the unemployed and the 30-44 age group is the largest category.

entry.title: Ρωγμές στην οικονομική κυριαρχία των ΗΠΑ
entry.summary: Investors are selling US bonds and foreign governments are pulling gold from the Fed as the global economy distances itself from America. Worries over the $40-trillion debt, overuse of sanctions and Trump's approach to the rule of law are questioning the US as an investment destination.

entry.title: Εφικτή, αλλά όχι εγγυημένη η συνέχεια της ανάκαμψης στην Ελλάδα
entry.summary: JPMorgan judges the continuation of Greece's recovery feasible but not guaranteed, with the key being a shift to a productivity-based growth model. It notes GDP is growing faster than the euro area, unemployment fell from 28% to 8% and debt is dropping, but durability hinges on private investment.

entry.title: Η Anthropic δημιούργησε βιολογικό εργαστήριο για την τεχνητή νοημοσύνη
entry.summary: AI company Anthropic, maker of Claude, has set up a 'wet' biology lab in the San Francisco Bay Area, moving from computational models to real experiments. The aim is to harness AI in the life sciences and, in the long run, to search for treatments for rare diseases.

entry.title: MI5: Παραδέχθηκε ότι έδωσε στοιχεία που βασίζονταν σε ψέματα σε τρία δικαστήρια για νεοναζί πληροφοριοδότη
entry.summary: Britain's MI5 admitted presenting evidence based on lies to three courts and that its officials were repeatedly untruthful in the case of a violent neo-Nazi informant, whose conduct the BBC had exposed. It is the first time the agency has formally accepted that lies were told to courts.
